exact_source_facts: the program rewards approved market makers
the stated activity is providing liquidity across a wide range of contracts in given categories
the only published next step is to contact an institutional email address to learn more or apply
missing_deterministic_economics: eligible categories markets accounts or jurisdictions
quote uptime size spread depth inventory or fill obligations
reward formula amount asset cadence cap and payment conditions
discretion withholding clawback suspension termination renewal and change rights
owned eligibility payment persistence and every incremental cost
decision.reason: The exact current public page confirms a distinct approved-market-maker reward program but publishes no deterministic eligibility, obligation, payout, or persistence economics. Accepting only an exact positive future payment after every cost would be tautological and would add no predictive or deployable market edge. The source therefore cannot prove a positive public floor, a profitable liquidity strategy, or an accepted scoped edge.
decision.why_public_floor_is_zero: Approval is unproved and the public page provides no reward amount, formula, asset, payment condition, duration, obligation, or cost evidence; providing liquidity itself creates inventory, adverse-selection, hedge, capital, and operating exposure.

prohibited_shortcuts: treating application availability approved status or qualitative rewards language as deterministic value
accepting a tautological exact positive future payment predicate without complete economics or owned receipt
contacting applying negotiating onboarding or configuring without separate explicit authority
manufacturing quotes orders fills liquidity volume uptime accounts or eligibility
self trading wash trading spoofing manipulative cancellation or non-executable quoting
ignoring adverse selection inventory hedge spread fee latency capital compliance tax opportunity or operating costs
retry_trigger: A complete current official Polymarket US market-maker contract publishing deterministic approval, eligibility, category, obligation, performance, reward, payment, withholding, clawback, suspension, termination, renewal, and change economics; or explicit separate read-only authority plus independently existing approved-market-maker status, exact executed agreement, legitimate organic qualifying liquidity, owned payment receipts, and every incremental cost. Contact, application, negotiation, onboarding, configuration, quote, order, cancellation, fill, transfer, fund, or state change requires separate explicit authority.
